I replied to Tobias in his thread in #central-random. I said I'd noted that Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is 84 seats and wouldn't use the number he posted earlier.

He said no action was needed, so I left #central-team alone. I also didn't repeat his earlier number in #central-random, since some people there may not be in #central-team. A seat count is account information, not a money figure, and Tobias posted it in this channel himself, so repeating it there needed no approval.
